risk.precision: of 370 newly high-risk skills, 289 are in known harmful collections; in a hand review of 30 of the other 81, 3 really send secrets or keys to an unvetted host, 14 are offensive-security/CTF notes with live attack commands, 11 are ordinary skills with a hard-coded server IP, 2 are pattern mistakes

precision.note: hand review of 40 random tagged skills under the final rules: 36 real offensive-security / pentest / CTF / malware-analysis material; 2 wrong (a "thinking modes" skill that mentions adversarial red teaming, an AI-inventory blast-radius analyser); 2 unclear (a proprietary-header file mentioning red-team, a defensive instrumentation step on a training range). Two earlier, looser versions scored 32/40 and 31/40 clear.

white_hat.recall_note: of 14 CTF / offensive-security notes found in the risk hand-check, 10 are tagged; the 4 missed have no name or description (raw payload lists or write-ups).
